text.description_html:
Thin Door Package for Hercular Single Cylinder Deadbolt, Mul-T-Lock MTL-PLK-HD-EXTRING-05

These extension rings are used for installing Hercular Single Cylinder Deadbolts on doors that are 1-3/8 inches thick.

This thin door installation kit consists of (1) extension ring.
